create_ExponentialSmoothing: create an ExponentialSmoothing instance to exponentially smooth and track dictionary-valued losses over time
run_setup_cuda_environment: run setup_cuda_environment to configure the GPU or CPU device for PyTorch via CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
test_pretty_print_dict: test pretty_print_dict to print a dictionary of arguments sorted alphabetically with aligned formatting
summarize_print_distribution: summarize print_distribution to display a histogram of counts as a sorted percentage distribution
review_sort_eval_metrics: review sort_eval_metrics to sort evaluation metrics by mean relative increase across perplexity, action_accuracy, and action_attribute
